card.name: Zero and null after negation
card.fires_on: The word zero (or null) right after a negating word such as non, not, or greater than, mostly in math and science text. Also fires on NOT NULL in database table definitions.

modes.label: Non-zero

modes.label: Zero as a bound
modes.description: The word zero after a comparison such as greater than.

modes.description: NULL after NOT in SQL column definitions.
